notes:
v0.3.3 — Smarter hardware detection + safer MAX.
• Fixed GPU detection on dual-graphics laptops and workstation cards (Quadro, Intel Arc) — the right GPU is picked now, with a manual CPU/GPU override if it's ever wrong.
• New: optional System Restore Point before every optimization (on by default) so you can roll back in one click.
• 'Keep Windows stable' now also protects the NVIDIA App during MAX, and is on by default.
• Discord is never killed during optimization.
• Cleaner dashboard, opens as a normal window with the correct taskbar icon, and now fully closes (no leftover background process).
